questions.question: When Sanballat and Tobiah heard Jerusalem's wall was being rebuilt, what did they and their allies plot to do?

questions.question: Nehemiah told the people of Jerusalem to remember the Lord and not fear their enemies. Whom did he say to fight for?

answers.text: The king of Persia and his throne
Their own honor and their good name
